summary.text: Phillip DeVillier is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 41 (Acadia, Evangeline and St. Landry parishes), and was elected in 2015, according to the official House member page.
The House lists Phillip R. DeVillier as Speaker of the House.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Phillip DeVillier's occupation as Owner, Devillier House Movers.
It lists education as St. Edmund Catholic School; Business Management, Louisiana State University.

The page lists committee assignments including ex officio seats on House committees, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
